models.yolo11m-obb: Ultralytics YOLO11m-OBB (DOTAv1), tiled 256px tiles, 25% overlap, imgsz 1024, conf>=0.25, rotated NMS (probIoU 0.4). Used for vehicles.
models.owlv2: google/owlv2-base-patch16-ensemble, tiled 640px, 20% overlap, prompts ['a house','a rooftop','a building','a person','a car','a truck'], score>=0.15 (cars >=0.30), NMS IoU 0.4. Used for houses/buildings and people; cars only where YOLO had no box.
